content: We argue that considering INLINEFORM0 in computation is beneficial for the following reasons. First, INLINEFORM1 contains additional information compared to INLINEFORM2 since it is not filtered by INLINEFORM3 . Thus a model that directly uses INLINEFORM4 does not rely solely on INLINEFORM5 for extracting information, due to the fact that it has access to the raw information INLINEFORM6 , as in temporal connections. In other words, INLINEFORM7 no longer has to take all responsibility for selecting useful features for both horizontal and vertical transitions, and the burden of selecting information is shared with INLINEFORM8 .
